hero.title: Hero24 – Comprehensive and reliable services for housing companies
hero.p1: Hero24 provides complete maintenance and upkeep services for housing companies, making property management as effortless and efficient as possible. We offer an all‑in‑one solution covering all property management needs 24/7.

meta.title: Join Hero24 | Careers
meta.description: Help build Hero24 — a modern, AI-enabled service platform for homes and properties. Apply for country launch and growth roles.

hero.title: Join Hero24
hero.subtitle: Help us build a scalable operating system for home and property services.

intro.p1: Hero24 is building a modern, technology-first and AI-enabled service platform for homes, properties and local service operations.
intro.p2: We connect customers, property owners, housing companies, landlords, property managers and businesses with reliable local professionals for moving, cleaning, handyman work, renovations, yard work, plumbing, electrical work, maintenance and other property-related services.
intro.p3: We are not building a traditional local service company. We are building a scalable operating system for home and property services.
intro.p4: We are looking for ambitious people who want to help build an international platform with strong technology, efficient operations and real-world local execution.
intro.p5: Hero24 needs builders across multiple areas: market expansion, sales, operations, customer support, finance, product, technology, AI automation and partnerships.
intro.p6: The right people for Hero24 are not just employees completing tasks. They are people who take ownership, improve systems, solve practical problems and create measurable long-term value.

priority.title: Current priority: Country Launch & Growth Roles
priority.body: Our current recruitment focus is on entrepreneurial, hands-on and AI-native country builders who can help Hero24 launch and grow in selected markets. These roles are for people who can open markets, recruit local Heroes, build service provider networks, generate customer demand, create B2B property partnerships and help us build scalable launch playbooks with global potential.

lookingFor.title: What kind of people we are looking for
lookingFor.intro: Hero24 is looking for people who combine practical execution with modern technology thinking. We are especially interested in people who can:
items: Take ownership and move fast
Build from zero when needed
Solve practical real-world problems
Improve systems and processes
Work across local operations, technology and customer needs
Communicate clearly with customers, partners, service providers and internal teams
Understand both B2C home services and B2B property services
Use AI, CRM systems and automation tools to work faster and smarter
Document what works and turn it into a repeatable operating model
Create measurable long-term value instead of only completing isolated tasks
lookingFor.launchIntro: For the current country launch and growth roles, we are especially interested in people who can:
launchItems: Contact customers, service providers and partners directly
Build B2B property and local business partnerships
lookingFor.outro: The best early team members are not only strong operators. They are people who can create systems, open markets and build long-term value.
